A habit tracker without the pressure. Tallies is a tally app for the things you'd rather just count.

A workout rep. A bird at the feeder. A row of knitting. A page read. A prayer bead. Anything you'd otherwise mark on the back of an envelope.

Swipe across the page and a felt-marker stroke appears. Five swipes give you the familiar four-and-a-cross. The page fills like a notebook, and it stays quiet: no notifications unless you ask, no streaks to break, no goals you didn't set.


WHAT PEOPLE CO

**APPLE DESIGN AWARD WINNER**

SCIENCE-BACKED METHOD TO BUILD BETTER HABITS
Building habits doesn’t have to be miserable. !Habits is the fun, guilt-free way to build better habits. No streaks. No guilt.

60 REPETITIONS
Science has shown that a new habit needs to be repeated 60 times for it to stick. It doesn’t matter if you miss a day or break a streak. It just matters that you do it 60 times. Great habit builders learn to ignore the goal and falling in love with the journey.

WE’LL BE YOUR GUID

*Inspired by the Never Miss Twice philosophy from Atomic Habits.

Build consistency without chasing perfection.

Most habit apps expect you to be perfect. Miss a day and your streak is gone.

Two Hearts is built around a simpler idea:

Don't miss twice.

You start with two hearts. Miss a day and lose one. Miss again before getting back on track and you break your streak. Life happens. The goal isn't perfection—it's returning.
